articles.image_title: Geldanlage im Krieg: Conceptual map illustrating disrupted shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz in 2026, one of the world’s most critical maritime chokepoints for global oil transport. The visualization highlights reduced vessel movement, clustered tankers, and constrained transit routes between the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman amid heightened geopolitical tensions. Ideal for editorial use covering geopolitics, oil markets, international trade, and crisis impact on global shipping networks.
